messages:
Security Ops: @channel Important: coordinated security advisory and immediate action required. Weve received confirmed indicators from a partner that a third-party integration may have had credentials exposed. As a precaution we're rolling out two controls: (1) immediate rotation of all vendor-facing service keys, (2) mandatory migration to scoped short-lived credentials (TTL <= 24h) for any service that talks to external partners. Please follow steps below. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Dina Rao: Clarify: does this only affect integrations listed under Partner Integrations, or all outbound service principals?

Security Ops: Primary focus is partner-facing principals and any role that has cross-account access to vendor systems. However, were asking all teams with outbound integrations to audit their service principals and rotate if they have static keys. We'll publish a CSV of impacted principals in the policy doc.

Frank Muller: Our data-exporter service posts to PartnerX. We use a long-lived key in Vault that rotates weekly. Is weekly rotation acceptable?

Security Ops: Weekly rotation still exceeds our new emergency threshold. For partner-facing keys, effective TTL must be <=24h. If Vault can switch to a daily rotation policy immediately, thats acceptable. If not, rotate manually now and open an exception ticket with justification.

SRE oncall: For quick rotation via CLI (example for Vault-managed AWS IAM user creds):
```
# rotate by creating a new IAM access key and update vault secret
aws iam create-access-key --user-name partner-data-uploader
vault kv put secret/partners/partnerx access_key=<NEW> secret_key=<NEW>
# update deployment and restart
kubectl rollout restart deployment/data-exporter
```
Tag your PRs with #sec-rotate so we can track.

Partner Integrations: We have a list of active partner principals in the shared sheet. Can we get an automated export of principals that have outbound permission?

Security Ops: Yes  well post the CSV to https://internal.redwood/policies/partner-credential-rotation-2026 with owner and current TTL column by EOD.

Frank Muller: For services that push to multiple partners, do we need separate credentials per partner?

Security Ops: Recommended: separate, scoped credentials per partner (least privilege) to limit blast radius. If you can't, isolate calls via a proxy service that holds the long-lived secret and provides short-lived tokens to callers.

Dina Rao: What about CI runners that call partner APIs during integration tests? They pull creds from vault and run nightly. Does that require OIDC?

Security Ops: For CI, prefer OIDC or ephemeral service accounts. If tests must use partner creds, ensure Vault issues <24h creds to the runner at job start and revoke after job completion. We're updating the CI templates; patch will be in the internal docs repo.

SRE oncall: Timeline and enforcement: immediate rotation requested now. We'll run a discovery sweep tonight to flag principals with TTL >24h. Automated enforcement (revocation) will run in 72 hours for any flagged partner-facing principals. Non-partner principals get a 14-day window.

Policy-bot: policy-update recorded: partner-credential-emergency-rotation (id: pc-2026-12). See https://internal.redwood/policies/pc-2026-12 for scope and CSV.

Partner Integrations: Noted. We'll start rotation for PartnerX and PartnerY. Can SRE help validate connectivity after key swap?

SRE oncall: Yes. If you schedule within the next 24 hours we can provide a post-rotation smoke test window and check logs for failures. Include the deployment and secret paths.

Frank Muller: Starting rotation now for data-exporter. Will post PR and tag #sec-rotate.

Dina Rao: Opening exception ticket for legacy analytics-worker. It cannot consume sub-daily creds until infra refactor. Adding IP allowlist and HSM storage as compensating controls.

Security Ops: Exception tickets must include timeline, compensating controls, and a remediation plan with dates. We prioritize partner-facing exceptions for review. Expect a 48-hour review SLA.

Policy-bot: scheduled: discovery-sweep-partner-principals at 2026-07-10T22:00Z. Enforcement-run scheduled: 2026-07-13T22:00Z for partner principals.

Security Ops: Action checklist: 1) Immediately rotate any partner-facing static keys (or change Vault rotation to <=24h), 2) Migrate to scoped, per-partner credentials or proxy pattern, 3) Update CI to use ephemeral creds or OIDC, 4) File exception ticket if you cannot remediate within 72 hours, include compensating controls, 5) Tag PRs with #sec-rotate. We'll host a 30-min office hour in 2 hours for questions.

Frank Muller: Thanks  will ping for pairing during the office hour.

Dina Rao: Acknowledged, starting work now.

Security Ops: Thanks team. Well post the CSV and a short how-to rotation playbook in the policy page shortly.
